websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Company domains or URLs, one per line (example.com or https://example.com). Optional when you give a dataset below.

datasetId.title: Dataset from another Actor (optional)
datasetId.description: Pick the results of a Google Maps Scraper run (or any dataset whose rows have a website field). Every distinct website in it is read, and each result keeps the place's name, address, phone and placeId so you can join it back.

websiteField.title: Website field in that dataset
websiteField.description: Name of the field that holds the website URL.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per site
maxPagesPerSite.description: The home page plus the most contact-like internal pages (contact, about, team, impressum...).

sameDomainEmailsOnly.title: Only emails on the site's own domain
sameDomainEmailsOnly.description: Drops addresses on other domains (for example a web agency's address in the footer).

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip pages the site disallows for all crawlers.

concurrency.title: Sites read at the same time
concurrency.description: Each site is a different host, so several can be read in parallel.
